## Chamber (security)
- φ-split keyword shares + AES-256-GCM
- 24-hour black box from first run (hard cut)
- Day $9 · Month $49 · Year $490
- Half the matching TRU8 tier
- No TRU8 production on this ladder
- SKUs: chamber-day | chamber-month | chamber-year

## TRU8 (compression)
- npm public demo: `npm i @cptasz13/tru8` (unscoped `tru8` is blocked by npm as similar to tr46/tsup)
- Public demos free with credit
- T_ZERO / T_DICT / T_TRISUM_HOT
- Day $19 and Month $99 = compression only
- Year $990 = Chamber + TRU8 for one year
- SKUs: tru8-day | tru8-month | tru8-year
- Legacy aliases: truchamber-* → tru8-*
